changesApplied: Split Step 8 into 8a (Template Extraction) and 8b (Prompt Embedding)
Added TechniqueTemplate dataclass specification to Step 8a
Added prompt composition algorithm to Step 8b
Expanded Step 1 description to include all dataclass interfaces
issuesIdentified: Step 8 was too complex (90-120 min scope)
Memory bank eviction policy not specified

keyDecisions: Classification step inserted as Step 1.5 (before Step 2 analysis)
Problem Type Confirmation as first blocking question (Question 0)
Manual fallback classification via keywords when Python unavailable
Hybrid problem classification with user confirmation
Phase-based technique composition (planning/implementation/verification)
Risk-based self-correction depth
Python scripts called by markdown commands
JSON configuration for technique mappings
33 problem subtypes across 8 categories (exceeds 22+ requirement)
Implementation techniques stored as array to support composition
Weighted keyword matching with penalty for generic keywords (add, new, feature)
Boost for domain-specific keywords (screen, api, refactor, etc.)
Context adjustment overrides base selection when appropriate
Cost estimation uses weighted scoring (1=low, 2=medium, 3=high)
Retry budget comes from config risk level (3/5/7/10)
10 risk factors with weights from -0.2 to 0.3
Negative factors (documentation_only, new_files_only) reduce risk
Score-to-level thresholds aligned with base scores (<0.35=LOW, <0.6=MEDIUM, <0.85=HIGH, >=0.85=CRITICAL)
CLI uses argparse with subcommand pattern
PlanOrchestrator integrates classifier, selector, and assessor
Formatted output with progress bars and status indicators
HTML comment markers for section delimiters (<!-- SECTION:NAME -->)
TechniqueTemplate dataclass with 7 fields: id, name, description, planning_section, implementation_section, verification_section, error_recovery_section, placeholders
Heuristic parsing for legacy templates via keyword patterns per technique
learnings: jsonschema module not available - created custom validation tests instead
Generic keywords like 'add', 'new', 'feature' need heavy penalty to avoid false positives
Domain-specific keywords should get extra weight for better accuracy
Phase enum must use .value for string comparison with config keys
Secondary techniques limited to 2 for composition sanity
Score-to-level thresholds must align with base risk scores from config to avoid unexpected level jumps
CLI needs to handle working directory changes when run from scripts dir
Technique-specific section patterns needed for heuristic parsing - each technique has unique header styles
pytest not available in environment - used unittest module instead
